name: M5.dcmotor
title: MuJoCo's DC motor
description: DC motor electrics + heat + cogging + LuGre
summary: MuJoCo's DC motor actuator (the dcmotor shortcut, mjs_setToDCMotor, MuJoCo 3.16): electrical dynamics, gain and bias (back-EMF, cogging, LuGre friction), with its parameters named and shaped as MuJoCo takes them. The simulator pins the MuJoCo release and the code that sets them.
equation: MuJoCo's own: mjDYN_DCMOTOR (electrical dynamics), mjGAIN_DCMOTOR (K or K/R), mjBIAS_DCMOTOR (back-EMF, cogging, LuGre friction)

output.name: tau_r
output.definition: The resisting torque at the output: what the motor must add to move the output as the inputs say.
output.sign: The joint feels -tau_r (a resisting torque opposes motion; ripple pushes and pulls with angle).

motorconst.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's motorconst (2 numbers), as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it; unit mujoco means MuJoCo's own (SI) units for each entry.
motorconst.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

resistance.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's resistance, the winding resistance the electrical model uses, as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it.
resistance.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

nominal.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's nominal (3 numbers), as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it; unit mujoco means MuJoCo's own (SI) units for each entry.
nominal.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

saturation.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's saturation (3 numbers), as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it; unit mujoco means MuJoCo's own (SI) units for each entry.
saturation.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

inductance.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's inductance (2 numbers), as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it; unit mujoco means MuJoCo's own (SI) units for each entry.
inductance.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

cogging.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's cogging (3 numbers), as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it; unit mujoco means MuJoCo's own (SI) units for each entry.
cogging.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

controller.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's controller (6 numbers), as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it; unit mujoco means MuJoCo's own (SI) units for each entry.
controller.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

thermal.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's thermal (6 numbers), as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it; unit mujoco means MuJoCo's own (SI) units for each entry.
thermal.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

lugre.definition: MuJoCo dcmotor's lugre (5 numbers), as mjs_setToDCMotor takes it; unit mujoco means MuJoCo's own (SI) units for each entry.
lugre.measured_by: measure-only board calibration, then the envelope ladder

mujoco.note: MuJoCo 3.16's dcmotor actuator (mjs_setToDCMotor) takes the terms as they are; no other backend implements it.

output_speed.definition: |v|, the output speed the terms were fitted or checked across.

current.definition: |i|, the winding current the electrics were fitted across.

assumptions: MuJoCo's own DC motor equations, as its release documents them.
